card.title: Proxy pool
card.hint: Accounts without a proxy of their own each get one proxy from the pool and keep it. A proxy that fails to connect hands its accounts to a healthy one. Changes apply at once.
card.modeHint: Send accounts without a proxy of their own through the pool. An account's own proxy always comes first.
card.modeNeedsProxy: Add a proxy before you turn the pool on.
card.emptyOnWarning: The pool is on but has no proxies, so accounts use the global proxy or connect directly.
card.fallbackHint: When no pool proxy is healthy, send requests through the global proxy, or directly when there is none. When off, those requests fail until a proxy recovers.
card.intervalHint: While the pool is on, connect to the Kiro host through each proxy on this schedule.
card.empty: No proxies yet. Add one to spread accounts over several outbound IP addresses.
card.removeBody: {name} leaves the pool. Its accounts move to the other proxies.
card.removeLastBody: {name} is the last proxy. Without it, accounts use the global proxy or connect directly.
editor.description: Accounts reach Kiro through this proxy. The password stays on the server and is never shown again.
editor.label: Label
editor.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
editor.added: The proxy was added and is being checked.
serverError.duplicate: This proxy is already in the pool.
serverError.notFound: This proxy is no longer in the pool.
serverError.empty: Add a proxy before you turn the pool on.
serverError.full: The pool is full: it holds at most 100 proxies.
